name: nawras-arcade
description: Bilingual RTL-first arcade engine: one codebase, PHP 8.3 dynamic + static export, license ledger with an audit trail, bucketed leaderboard (8 CloudArcade-compatible period types), SSRF-hardened providers, a self-proving installer and schema migrations.

scripts.test: npm run -s bridge && python3 tools/verify_php.py && python3 tools/prove_runtime.py && python3 tools/gen_schema_sql.py --verify && python3 tools/gen_license_rules.py --verify && python3 -c "import json;[json.load(open(f)) for f in ['db/schema.json','db/migrations.json','db/license_rules.json','db/oss_pack.json','composer.json']];print('✓ json valid')"
